replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: To solve an ax²+bx+c=0 equation: 1. Identify coefficients a,b,c. 2. Calculate the discriminant b²-4ac. 3. Find stationary points by: 1. Calculating the first derivative dy/dx. 2. Setting dy/dx equal to zero and solving for x values. 3. Substituting those x values back into original function f(x) to get corresponding y coordinates. These are your stationary points.
